messages:
anna: flagging an anomaly: several accounts show token usage gaps between 2026-02-20 00:00 and 02:15 UTC. Looks like ingestion delays, not customer-side. Opening thread for remediation steps.
raj: Thanks @anna. I saw the same in ingest logs: consumer-lag spikes around that window. I'll take pipeline investigation.
tia: Finance here 10: If invoices for that period already posted we'll need to prepare credit entries. Can you quantify affected token totals?
raj: Quick query shows ~4,720 tokens underreported across 17 customers. Exporting list now.
anna: Pushing CSV to the drive: https://internal.redwood/drive/ingest-gaps-20260220.csv. Includes rough deltas and invoice IDs.
billing-bot: System notice: Billing run completed for 2026-02-21. For retroactive adjustments use tag #billing-adjustments.
raj: Root cause: transient Kafka consumer restart + backpressure on meter-ingest. Hotfix: increase consumer max.poll.interval.ms and add preflight sequence checks. Deploying patch to canary. ETA 1.5h.
tia: Good. I'll hold on customer communications until we have final reconcile numbers. We need legal loop-in if any enterprise contracts exceed tolerance thresholds.
anna: Can we also add a mitigation: weekly reconciliation job comparing meter vs ledger by account? This incident feels like a recurring class (ingest lag at scale).
sre-lead: Yes please. Add a scheduled job + an alert: delta > 0.5% or absolute >500 tokens triggers paged incident. Also log an SLO guard.
raj: Canary looks clean. Running dry-run backfill on staging to validate idempotency. Backfill logic: check ledger sequence, skip duplicates, emit per-account checksums.
tia: Finance request: produce provisional credit batch CSV with columns: customer_id, invoice_id, missed_tokens, credit_amount_usd. We can stage but send only after reconciliation.
anna: I'll annotate the CSV with invoice status and whether payment cleared. Helps prioritize who gets immediate credits vs next cycle adjustments.
raj: Dry-run matched 4,720 tokens. Starting prod backfill with throttling to avoid load. Will post job ID.
tia: Once you have reconciliation output, I'll open ticket INV-5018 and tag customers. I'll also prepare templated communication.
raj: Prod backfill job complete, job id backfill:2026-02-20-01. Reconciliation report: ledger now matches meter for all 17 accounts.
billing-bot: Automated entry: Credit batch prepared INV-5018 created by tia. Processing window ~72h.
tia: I created INV-5018 and uploaded draft credit memos. Target send: next business day. Tagging @legal for review of any contract-sensitive customers.
anna: Action items recap:
- raj: pipeline patch + backfill (done)
- tia: create credit batch INV-5018 + customer comms (in progress)
- sre-lead: add weekly meter/ledger reconciliation + alert (todo)
- anna: compiled CSV and annotated invoice states (done)
Please add any missed owners.
sre-lead: I'll add the weekly job to ops-schedule and create an alert runbook. Also recommend a postmortem note summarizing recurrence and long-term fixes (consumer autoscaling, circuit breakers).
tia: FYI finance will close the correction loop after credits go out. I'll update this thread when INV-5018 is processed. :thumbsup:
anna: thanks all. leaving this thread open until credits sent.
